units.source_text: K恢复原籍是在他一年级的时候，以后直到二年级上半学期，大约一年半的时间，他都是靠自己打工来维持生活的。

en.t: K had his name restored to his original family register when he was a first-year student; afterward, until the first half of his second year, for about a year and a half, he supported himself by working.

units.source_text: 然而，过度劳累显然已经渐渐影响了他的健康和精神。

en.t: However, the excessive labor had clearly begun to affect his health and his spirit little by little.

units.source_text: 再加上离不离开养父家这一令人烦恼的问题，他渐渐变得感伤起来。

en.t: Added to that was the troubling question of whether or not to leave his adoptive father's house, and he gradually became sentimental.

units.source_text: 有时他说，只有自己是独自背负着世上所有不幸的人。

en.t: At times he would say that he alone was the person bearing all the misfortunes in the world by himself.

units.source_text: 我若予以反驳，他立刻会激动起来。

en.t: If I argued against this, he would immediately become agitated.

units.source_text: 他还觉得自己一片光明的前途渐渐远去了，因此焦虑不安。

en.t: He also felt that the bright future before him was gradually receding into the distance, and this made him anxious and restless.

units.source_text: 开始做学问的时候，人们通常是胸怀远大抱负踏上新旅途的，

en.t: When people first begin their studies, they usually set out on a new journey with great ambitions,

units.source_text: 然而过了一两年，临近毕业之时，

en.t: but after a year or two has passed, when graduation draws near,

units.source_text: 突然发现自己前进的脚步太慢，多数人自然会在此时感到失望。

en.t: they suddenly realize that their progress has been too slow, and most people naturally feel disappointed at that point.

units.source_text: K也是如此，只不过他的焦虑比一般人要猛烈得多。

en.t: It was the same with K, except that his anxiety was far more intense than that of most people.

units.source_text: 我终于认识到，最重要的是让他尽快平静下来。

en.t: I finally realized that the most important thing was to calm him down as quickly as possible.
